title: RelationHistoryEntry
description: A time boundary or period at which a relation's computed evidential state differs. The history is COMPUTED from evidence and source-state admissibility; the API MUST NOT require a copied relation-level temporal interval. `boundaryCauseRefs` MAY reference the authoritative transition (in the substrate) that caused the boundary, when the profile exposes such transitions.

relationId.description: The relation whose history entry this is.

profileId.description: The grounding profile under which the history was computed.

profileVersion.description: Exact version of that grounding profile.

policyId.description: The admission policy under which the states in this history were computed. Two policies can yield different histories for the same relation and the same grounding profile, so a history serialized without its policy is ambiguous. When the caller does not name one, the resolved default MUST be reported here.

policyVersion.description: Exact version of that admission policy.

state.description: The evidential state that holds over this period.

from.description: Inclusive start of the period. Absent means unbounded in the past.

to.description: Exclusive end of the period. Absent means the period is currently open.

supportingEvidenceIds.description: Supporting evidence bases admissible over this period.

refutingEvidenceIds.description: Refuting evidence bases admissible over this period.

boundaryCauseRefs.description: Optional external references explaining what caused this boundary (e.g. an authoritative transition identifier in the profile's substrate).
